svg.title: E-commerce Microservices
svg.desc: E-commerce Microservices — Eight Spring Boot services behind a Keycloak-secured gateway, with Eureka discovery, a config server, Kafka-driven order and payment events, and Zipkin tracing. 8 services · Docker Compose.
